seoTitle: Scottsdale Unified Calendar 2027–28: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: See Scottsdale Unified’s 2027–28 first and last days, breaks, early-release dates, conferences, dismissal times, and official calendar PDFs.
heroSummary: Scottsdale Unified students start the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 9, 2027. The last day for students is Thursday, May 25, 2028. The calendar includes 180 student instructional days, Fall Break from October 11–15, Winter Break from December 20–31, and Spring Break from March 13–17. January 3 is a staff preparation day with no students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 4.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against SUSD’s district calendar page and the official 2027–28 English PDF. The calendar was approved by the SUSD Governing Board on May 14, 2024.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF lists 180 student instructional days and is marked Board Approved: May 14, 2024.
The PDF lists January 3, 2028 as a staff preparation day with no students, separate from the December 20–31 Winter Break range.
The PDF separates all-grade early releases, elementary and K–8 conference early releases, middle school conference early releases, and high school final exam early releases.
The second page of the PDF lists school directory bell schedules and early-release times, including the K–8 campuses named on the calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Scottsdale Unified start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Scottsdale Unified students start the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for Scottsdale Unified in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 11, through Friday, October 15, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3, 2028 is a staff preparation day with no students, so students return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SUSD K–8 schools follow the conference schedule?
calendarFaqs.a: The district PDF names Cheyenne Traditional School, Copper Ridge School, and Echo Canyon School in the K–8 conference early-release note.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the last day of school an early-release day?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Thursday, May 25, 2028 is the last day of school and is marked as early release for all grades, including pre-K.

calendarFaqs.q: What time does SUSD dismiss students on early-release days?
calendarFaqs.a: The district PDF lists 1:15 p.m. for most elementary schools and 12:20 p.m. for most middle and high schools. Mountainside Middle School and SUSD’s K–8 schools follow the times shown in the district PDF, so check your school’s bell schedule before planning pickup.

customSections.label: How Scottsdale Unified’s Calendar Works
customSections.content: SUSD does not use one early-release schedule for every school. Some dates apply to all grades, while conference and final-exam schedules vary by school level. Use the district calendar for the date and your school’s bell schedule for the dismissal time.

rows: The calendar marks several dates as early release for all grades, including pre-K.
October and spring conference windows are split between elementary/K–8 schools and middle schools. The K–8 note applies to Cheyenne, Copper Ridge, and Echo Canyon.
High school finals and early release
High school finals are scheduled for December 15–17 and May 23–25. December early release applies only to high schools, while the May dates are early-release days for all grades.
January 3 is a staff preparation day with no students. Classes resume January 4.
The district PDF lists early-release times by school. Check your school’s bell schedule for the latest dismissal time.
A Spanish-language district calendar PDF is available for 2027–28.

customSections.label: SUSD Early-Release Times by School Type
customSections.content: The district PDF lists an early-release time for each school. Most elementary schools dismiss at 1:15 p.m., while most middle and high schools dismiss at 12:20 p.m. Mountainside Middle School and the district’s K–8 schools follow the times shown below, so confirm the schedule with your school before arranging pickup or childcare.
